findings.finding: Normal migration success removed the sealed production runners while durable state still remained DATABASE_PRODUCTION_INTENT. A crash after either removal made strict recovery quiescence fail with PRODUCTION_RUNNER_MISSING, so the applied database post-state could not be reconciled.
findings.required_remediation: Persist and audit an exact runner-retirement intent before the first removal, make retirement idempotent for exact absence while retaining identity checks for surviving objects, and recover to the sealed terminal post-state only after the database post-state is revalidated.
